title: Connected object of a category
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category. An object $X$ of $\mathcal C$ is *connected* if $X$ is not initial and for every monomorphism $i:Y\to X$ either $Y$ is initial or $i$ is an isomorphism (initial objects and monomorphisms as in [def-galois-initial-mono]).
